science.qualification: Shared neutral gray display convention for a planet with no image or measured color in this package; a sphere of the published radius, lit by its own star, whose measured color (#ffc787, the color dataset of gj-238 (src/objects/gj-238/source/photometry/stellar-color.json)) tints the gray at the same brightness.
